system.name: CrewAI Conversational RAG
system.description: A multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system built on CrewAI that answers questions grounded in a structured knowledge base.
system.architecture: Sequential multi-agent pipeline: Retriever → Aggregator → Synthesizer

llm_providers.notes: Recommended provider. Free tier available at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey

agents.name: Knowledge Retrieval Specialist
agents.description: Searches and retrieves accurate facts and excerpts from knowledge base documents. Grounded strictly in indexed documentation.

agents.name: Aggregator Host Specialist
agents.description: Aggregates, cross-examines, and synthesizes knowledge excerpts. Resolves conflicts, deduplicates findings, and optionally inspects local host diagnostics.

agents.name: Conversational Synthesizer
agents.description: Synthesizes retrieved and aggregated knowledge into warm, natural, and well-cited conversational responses for the user.

tools.name: Knowledge Base Search
tools.description: Keyword and relevance-based search across all knowledge base documents (.md, .txt, .json, .rst, .csv).
tools.output: Ranked excerpts with source document names

tools.name: List Knowledge Documents
tools.description: Lists all indexed documents in the knowledge directory with file sizes.

tools.name: Read Complete Document
tools.description: Reads the full content of a specific knowledge base document by name.

tools.name: Aggregator Host Status Inspector
tools.description: Inspects local host system telemetry, CPU architecture, and Windows AggregatorHost.exe process health.

tools.name: JSON Knowledge Search
tools.description: Searches exclusively through structured JSON knowledge files, returning parsed key-value data relevant to the query.

steps.task: Search knowledge base and extract relevant evidence
Aggregate, cross-reference, and validate retrieved facts
Synthesize final conversational response with citations

api_endpoints.chat: POST /api/chat — Send a message to the multi-agent pipeline
api_endpoints.upload: POST /api/upload — Upload a new knowledge document
api_endpoints.ai_info: GET /api/ai/info — AI system metadata and agent roster
